items.instruction: Always stay inside the arena.
items.rationale: All steps in bounds.

items.instruction: Remain within arena bounds throughout the episode.
items.rationale: All steps in bounds.

items.instruction: Never get tagged.
items.rationale: Absorbing safety requirement.

items.instruction: At no point may a controlled boat be tagged.
items.rationale: Absorbing safety requirement.

items.instruction: Eventually capture the enemy flag.
items.rationale: No additional no-tag clause.

items.instruction: Score at least once before the episode ends.
items.rationale: No additional no-tag clause.

items.instruction: Eventually reach the home flag stand.
items.rationale: Home means flag vicinity, not own half.

items.instruction: At some time reach within catch radius of our flag home.
items.rationale: Home means flag vicinity, not own half.

items.instruction: Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
items.rationale: Inclusive sequencing as specified by benchmark context.

items.instruction: Obtain the opposing flag, then eventually score.
items.rationale: Inclusive sequencing as specified by benchmark context.

items.instruction: Carry the flag and capture it strictly later.
items.rationale: Strong next distinguishes strict from inclusive order.

items.instruction: At some point possess the flag; score at a later step, not that same step.
items.rationale: Strong next distinguishes strict from inclusive order.

items.instruction: Reach home and then eventually capture.
items.rationale: Reverse witness must not suffice.

items.instruction: Visit our flag home, followed by a score.
items.rationale: Reverse witness must not suffice.

items.instruction: Whenever carrying the flag, eventually reach our flag stand.
items.rationale: Response includes same step and applies at every time.

items.instruction: Every possession of the flag must be followed by reaching home.
items.rationale: Response includes same step and applies at every time.

items.instruction: Whenever we have the flag, eventually score.
items.rationale: Vacuously true if no possession; no invented eventual possession.

items.instruction: Each time a boat carries the flag, the team must eventually capture.
items.rationale: Vacuously true if no possession; no invented eventual possession.

items.instruction: Whenever an attacker is forward, no teammate may be tagged.
items.rationale: Direction of implication matters.

items.instruction: If an attacker is beyond midfield, the team must be untagged at that step.
items.rationale: Direction of implication matters.

items.instruction: Keep designated defender agent 0 behind the centerline at all times.
items.rationale: Designated role only, not existential quantification.

items.instruction: Agent zero must always remain in our half.
items.rationale: Designated role only, not existential quantification.

items.instruction: While an attacker is forward, agent 0 must remain behind midfield.
items.rationale: Do not replace this with a global defender obligation.

items.instruction: If any attacker crosses into enemy territory, keep the designated defender in our half.
items.rationale: Do not replace this with a global defender obligation.

items.instruction: Stay in bounds and eventually capture without getting tagged.
items.rationale: Three independent clauses.

items.instruction: Always remain inside, never be tagged, and score before the deadline.
items.rationale: Three independent clauses.

items.instruction: Always stay in bounds. Pick up the enemy flag and then capture it.
items.rationale: Safety plus ordered task.

items.instruction: Remain inside the arena while completing possession followed by capture.
items.rationale: Safety plus ordered task.

items.instruction: Stay untagged until capturing, and do capture.
items.rationale: Strong until, not weak until and not global no-tag.

items.instruction: Avoid tags until the first score; scoring must eventually happen.
items.rationale: Strong until, not weak until and not global no-tag.

items.instruction: On the next step, be inside the arena.
items.rationale: Strong next rejects a one-state trace.

items.instruction: The immediately following state must be in bounds.
items.rationale: Strong next rejects a one-state trace.

items.instruction: If you have the flag, return to your side.
items.rationale: Own-half predicate is absent; home would silently strengthen the instruction.

items.instruction: When carrying it, go back to our half.
items.rationale: Own-half predicate is absent; home would silently strengthen the instruction.

items.instruction: Keep one defender behind the centerline.
items.rationale: Existential role cannot be replaced with designated agent 0.

items.instruction: At least one team member should stay back to defend.
items.rationale: Existential role cannot be replaced with designated agent 0.

items.instruction: If an opponent approaches, retreat toward home.

items.instruction: Fall back when the enemy gets close.
items.rationale: Approach/close and retreat direction have no grounded AP.

items.instruction: One attacker should capture while another supports.
